title: Normalise the input
summary: Scales the network's input: none, or ImageNet's channel means and spreads on the tiled grey.
does: A forward pre-hook on the network's input (tools/train_blocks.py NORMALISERS): none leaves the crops in 0..1 as they are; imagenet subtracts ImageNet's channel means and divides by its spreads, the statistics the pretrained weights saw. It changes no type.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: 2-D frames or crops the network reads.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data: the hook lives inside the model.

generic.why: The normalisers are hooks on the 2-D network's input (tools/train_blocks.py); a volume or a clip would need hooks of its own.
